verdict.rationale: Gitea is a self-hosted Git service, not an agent, so publishing an MCP server is an applicable axis. A probe confirms an official MCP server documented under the Gitea organization at gitea.com/gitea/gitea-mcp, which covers the core of the story. However, the evidence is a single pointer with no detail on how an agent connects. Missing for 10: documented tool coverage (repos/issues/PRs), transport and setup/auth instructions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting through it.
